description: Train a neural network to approximate conformal maps for parameterized domains, then use the differentiable surrogate to optimize the Bloch radius via gradient descent. PINNs enforce Cauchy-Riemann equations as soft constraints.
mathematical_formalization: NN f_theta: D -> C. Loss: L = ||partial_{z_bar} f_theta||^2 + lambda * boundary_loss. Optimize B(Omega) = sup_z |f'_theta(z)|(1-|z|^2)/2 over domain parameters.
analogical_connections: PINN for Cauchy-Riemann ~ physics-informed fluid dynamics
Domain parameterization ~ latent space in generative models
implementation_hypothesis: Complex-valued neural network. Train on boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation for f'(z) and Bloch radius. B-spline domain boundaries optimized via backpropagation.
experiment_seed: Train PINN for disk-to-strip conformal map. Verify accuracy. Then parameterize domains with B-splines and optimize Bloch radius.
